create_environment_subclass: create a subclass of Base that implements _reset and _step for a custom dm_env environment
implement_reset_method: implement the abstract _reset method to return a timestep namedtuple for environment initialization
implement_step_method: implement the abstract _step method to process an action and return a timestep namedtuple
reset_environment: call reset on a Base environment instance to start a new episode and get the first timestep
step_environment: call step with an action on a Base environment to advance and auto-reset on LAST timestep
